visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair sits on the wooden porch of a traditional Japanese house. She is wearing a black tank top and beige trousers, holding a blue cup. The background features a meticulously kept garden with a green bonsai tree and a red maple under bright natural daylight. (2) The woman walks down a paved road away from the camera, her hands behind her back. The setting is a quiet residential street with traditional houses and green hills in the distance under a clear sky. (3) The scene shifts to the bustling city of Osaka, showcasing glass skyscrapers and modern architecture. Many pedestrians are visible, and the camera pans upwards to emphasize the height of the buildings. (4) The woman enters a large, brightly lit retail store with a sign that reads '@cosme OSAKA'. The interior is a large open-plan space with numerous display islands and people browsing. (5) Close-up shots of cosmetic products, specifically 'LuLuLun' face masks in various colors like purple, blue, and yellow. The woman's hands are shown interacting with the packaging. (6) The woman applies a purple sheet mask to her face, smoothing it over her skin. She is in a room with soft indoor lighting, showing her face close-up with butterfly-themed nail art. (7) She demonstrates a skincare jar called 'LuLuPad,' using tweezers to pick up a round cotton pad. Later, she is lying on a bed in a red tank top, using the pad on her face. (8) More views of the store interior are shown, highlighting specific brand sections like '&be' and 'laugh'. The woman walks through the aisles with a shopping basket. (9) She tests a liquid contour product on the back of her hand, then applies a streak of it to her cheek while sitting in a traditional room with a man. (10) The woman and the man are shown wearing white sheet masks simultaneously, looking at the camera and laughing. The lighting is warm and domestic.
